met_analysis:
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Ferozepur, Patiala, Bareilly, Lucknow, centre of Depression over north Jharkhand & adjoining southwest Bihar thence southeastwards to Northwest Bay of Bengal.
The trough now runs from the cyclonic circulation associated with the Depression over north Jharkhand & adjoining southwest Bihar to South Gujarat Region across Madhya Pradesh at 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Punjab & neighbourhood at 7.6 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over central Uttar Pradesh and now seen between 1.5 & 3.1 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over north Haryana & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
